$comment: llama.cpp llama-server runtime packs for the local translation LLM, run as a helper process by process_host (127.0.0.1 only, random API key, kill-on-close Job Object). Owned by P1-E; decision record docs/adr/0005-process-host-llama.md.

Official ggml-org Windows x64 release zips of build b11146 (commit 7fe450e19305b828c199d602c23a8337aaa1f03b; the binaries of llama.cpp v0.5.0, 2026-09-23). Sizes and sha256 are GitHub's asset digests; the Vulkan zip was downloaded and re-hashed locally.

Only llama-server.exe (a 9 KB launcher for llama-server-impl.dll) and the DLLs are installed; the other tools in the zips are skipped. Vulkan is the default GPU pack (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel), CPU the fallback, CUDA 13 opt-in (its entry also installs llama.cpp's CUDA 13.4 runtime DLLs next to the server).
Upgrade: bump every id's version and pins together, then re-run the P1-E smoke test (process_host::tests::llama_server_smoke).

entries.title: llama.cpp server (Vulkan)
entries.description: Runs local translation models (GGUF) on the GPU through Vulkan: NVIDIA, AMD and Intel graphics. Started by Sigil as a helper process that only listens on this PC.

entries.title: llama.cpp server (CPU)
entries.description: Runs local translation models (GGUF) on the processor, picking the fastest instruction set this CPU supports. For PCs without a suitable GPU.

entries.title: llama.cpp server (CUDA 13)
entries.description: Runs local translation models (GGUF) on NVIDIA GPUs through CUDA 13, with its CUDA runtime included. Needs driver R580 or newer and a Turing (GTX 16 / RTX 20) or newer GPU.
